thread:
maya.peopleops: Hi team, employee had ACL repair on 04/03 and started PT at 'MotionWorks Rehab'. Claim 984-PT-773 denied as out-of-network. MotionWorks says they submitted with their usual billing info but insurer says provider on claim didn't match network record. We do have a prior auth PA-9012 covering post-op PT. Any guidance on getting this rebilled in-network and a quick proof-of-coverage the clinic can accept so they don't cancel sessions?

rachel.benefits: Two quick things: 1) clinic resubmission with corrected billing provider NPI/TIN is necessary; 2) we can issue a proof-of-coverage letter (not a payment guarantee) the member or clinic can use for scheduling.

clinic-liason: From experience, clinics often bill under a corporate tax ID instead of the individual therapist's NPI. If insurer's provider file expects the therapist NPI, mismatch triggers OON. MotionWorks should resubmit using the rendering therapist's NPI and include the facility/billing TIN that matches insurer records.

tom.hr: Can benefits generate the exact wording we should ask the clinic to put on the claim form so it's clear? Member is anxious and traveling Friday.

rachel.benefits: Suggested claim note: "Please reprocess claim 984-PT-773: prior authorization PA-9012 applies. Correct billing provider NPI/TIN to match insurer provider file; denial was for provider credential mismatch. Please attach PT plan of care and itemized bill." Ask them to populate box 23/claim remark with PA-9012 and tick reprocessing/reconsideration.

maya.peopleops: Perfect. @benefits-bot can you create the temporary proof-of-coverage PDF text we use for these? Include plan name Redwood Core PPO and contact for claim inquiries.

benefits-bot: Draft proof-of-coverage: "Redwood Inference 3 Member proof of coverage (informational only, not a guarantee of payment). Member: [NAME]. Plan: Redwood Core PPO. Active coverage: 01/01/2026 - 12/31/2026. Prior authorization on file: PA-9012 (for PT post-operative rehab). For claim status call insurer 1-800-555-0199 or submit portal inquiry"

clinic-liason: Add a line that says: "Please present PA-9012 to scheduling/billing to confirm authorization details." That helps schedulers.

maya.peopleops: I'll DM the member the PDF and the clinic script. Rachel, once the clinic confirms they will resubmit, can you open an insurer escalation ticket referencing PA-9012 and claim 984-PT-773 so reprocessing is tracked?

rachel.benefits: Yep. I'll file escalation and attach the EOB + prior auth. If insurer resists, we'll attach PT notes and letter from surgeon supporting medical necessity.

maya.peopleops: Thanks everyone. I'll update here after the clinic responds. :thumbsup:
